annual.note: The FY2026 10-K (filed 2026-08-18) is both the last annual report and the latest periodic filing on or before 2026-10-21 (Q1 FY2027 ends 2026-09-25 and has not been filed; ARS and proxy filed 2026-10-20 add no financial statements). TTM is therefore identical to the annual base with zero YTD and prior-YTD components. Fabrinet is a Cayman Islands company filing 10-K/10-Q in USD; NYSE listing is the ordinary share (no ADS). No interest-bearing debt at 2026-06-26. Subsequent event: on 2026-08-17 the Thai subsidiary borrowed a Thai baht 2.50 billion term loan (about $75.0 million) under the amended 2019 credit facility (Note 19); it is not on the 2026-06-26 balance sheet, so debt is 0 here (the proceeds are also not in June cash). Operating lease liabilities are excluded from debt. FY2026 other income of $57.0 million includes a $56.7 million gain on non-marketable equity securities (below operating income). Purchase obligations and commitments to third parties $3.15 billion and capex commitments $108.1 million at 2026-06-26 are not debt. Litigation (Casix, RMB 400 million claim accepted for retrial by the PRC Supreme Court on 2026-07-30) is unquantified and not accrued. Unvested RSUs/PSUs are not yet issued shares and are excluded from sharesOutstanding.
